entries.dialogueText: For the first time, I walked alone through the hall of the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could carry on without my Grand V..."
entries.dialogueText: I could carry on without my Grand Vizier -- the position was soon to disappear, anyway. But it was nonetheless a curious sensation, as if I were missing a limb.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could carry on without my Grand V..."
entries.dialogueText: I could carry on without my Grand Vizier -- I had to. But it was nonetheless a curious sensation, as if I were missing a limb.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Politicians in their variously colo..."
entries.dialogueText: Politicians in their variously colored sashes hurried past me, some bowing as they did so, others averting their eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Politicians in their variously colo..."
entries.dialogueText: Politicians in their variously colored sashes hurtled down the hall, bowing in greeting as they passed me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Side by side, Hugo and I walked onc..."
entries.dialogueText: Side by side, Hugo and I walked once more through the hall of the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Politicians in their variously colo..."
entries.dialogueText: Politicians in their variously colored sashes hurried past us, some bowing, others walking upright with averted gazes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Politicians in their variously colo..."
entries.dialogueText: Politicians in their variously colored sashes hurried past us, bowing as they did.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your triumph in Zille is the talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your triumph in Zille is the talk of the capital, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your trip to Wehlen is the talk of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your trip to Wehlen is the talk of the capital, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And after Her Highness' wedding to..."
entries.dialogueText: "And after Her Highness' wedding to Duke Reinhart, the stage will be set for Rizia to become whole again."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Have no fear. Our international pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have no fear. Our international partners will stop this referendum nonsense in its tracks."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Have no fear. I know the citizens..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have no fear. I know the citizens of Zille still consider themselves Rizian at heart."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We're all looking forward to putti..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're all looking forward to putting the last 28 years behind us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And once we take Pales, the full r..."
entries.dialogueText: "And once we take Pales, the full reunification of Rizia will be complete."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille is unimportant. We are well..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille is unimportant. We are well on our way to retaking Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't try to sugarcoat it, Uncle...."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't try to sugarcoat it, Uncle. We're going to lose Zille and Pales alike."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After the loss of Golden Shield, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the loss of Golden Shield, we really needed a win."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who cares about Zille? Who are the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who cares about Zille? Who are these people refusing to bow to me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet here I am, once again, wasting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet here I am, once again, wasting my time in the House of Delegates. I'm telling you, Hugo, this institution has to go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sacrifices had to be made. But it'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sacrifices had to be made. But it'll all be worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you had another candidate i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you had another candidate in mind for Her Highness. But I hope you'll agree I made the right choice."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Under the circumstances, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Under the circumstances, yes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As long as reunification goes as p..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as reunification goes as planned, yes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo grimaced.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Sotelato supporters, from the look..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato supporters, from the looks of it. And I thought it couldn't get any worse than Manus Sazon."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No good thing comes without sacrif..."
entries.dialogueText: "No good thing comes without sacrifice."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What a grand day that will be.""
entries.dialogueText: "What a grand day that will be."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Definitely a reason to celebrate.""
entries.dialogueText: "Definitely a reason to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With any luck, both will be ours o..."
entries.dialogueText: "With any luck, both will be ours once more."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please, Your Majesty. Try to keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. Try to keep up a strong front for the Delegates."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his voice."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his voice.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Lately I've begun to think you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lately I've begun to think you're right about that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked both ways uneasily."
entries.dialogueText: He looked both ways uneasily.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We can stop attending these sessio..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can stop attending these sessions if you like. But they're not harming anyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't have done it without my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't have done it without my council's invaluable advice."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are too modest.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are too modest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as our government stays st..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as our government stays strong, we will win this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We may have to make sacrifices. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may have to make sacrifices. But it'll all be worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm curious, Hugo. How would you f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm curious, Hugo. How would you feel about the House of Delegates taking on a larger role in government?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and I took our usual seats on..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and I took our usual seats on the dais.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me uneasily."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me uneasily.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With its current makeup, I would s..."
entries.dialogueText: "With its current makeup, I would strongly advise against that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me with interest."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me with interest.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Baroness de Rava has done well for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Baroness de Rava has done well for herself as House Speaker. It would be appropriate to reward her in some way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I entered the chamber and took my u..."
entries.dialogueText: I entered the chamber and took my usual seat on the dais. The one beside me remained empty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates filed in, followed sh..."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates filed in, followed shortly by Daria de Rava and House Speaker Adarfo Sotelato.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Soletato approached his podium,..."
entries.dialogueText: As Soletato approached his podium, I saw he wasn't wearing a sash or even a tie. He had a harshness to his features that made him seem older than his years.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates filed in, followed sh..."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates filed in, followed shortly by Daria de Rava and House Speaker Manus Sazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My future son-in-law bowed before m..."
entries.dialogueText: My future son-in-law bowed before my seat, then straightened up confidently and rang the bell.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus bowed before my seat, then st..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus bowed before my seat, then straightened up confidently and rang the bell.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Good afternoon, everyone.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, everyone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes were fixed on Hugo and mys..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes were fixed on Hugo and myself with a steely intensity.

entries.dialogueText: The Delegates filed in, followed shortly by House Speaker Daria de Rava and opposition speaker Adarfo Sotelato.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates filed in, followed sh..."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates filed in, followed shortly by Manus Sazon and House Speaker Daria de Rava.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Good afternoon, everyone.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, everyone."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your Majesty. Your Grace. Madam de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Your Grace. Madam de Rava."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes were fixed on me with a st..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes were fixed on me with a steely intensity.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your Majesty. Madam de Rava.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Madam de Rava."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rang the bell, its high, clear s..."
entries.dialogueText: He rang the bell, its high, clear sound contrasting with the raspy edge of his speaking voice.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We open this session by acknowledg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We open this session by acknowledging the success of the Zille Agreement and the imminent return of Rizia's long-lost territory."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We open this session by acknowledg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We open this session by acknowledging that our attempts to negotiate the return of the Zille region have not borne fruit."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We open this session by acknowledg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We open this session by acknowledging the imminent return of Rizia's long-lost territory. Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates broke into applause,..."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates broke into applause, with Daria clapping loudest of all. Adarfo held up a hand for silence.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""This should be a cause for celebra..."
entries.dialogueText: "This should be a cause for celebration, as we welcome back our brothers and sisters who have been separated from us for so many years."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Let us not forget that with our ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us not forget that with our expanded territory comes expanded responsibility."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country that is sending young an..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country that is sending young and vulnerable citizens to die on the front lines of a senseless invasion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cast his gaze around the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: He cast his gaze around the chamber.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country that is sending young, v..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country that is sending young, vulnerable citizens to kill their own neighbors on the front lines of a senseless invasion."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country where the wealthy and po..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country where the wealthy and powerful luxuriate on massive estates, while those who perform the real labor can't afford housing."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country where foreign-born worke..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country where foreign-born workers extract resources of incalculable value, but are relegated to the very bottom of society."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country where the wealthy and po..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country where the wealthy and powerful luxuriate on massive estates, while those who perform the real labor live in squalor."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country that presents a shiny, g..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country that presents a shiny, golden front to the world while forcing its workers to grub for pennies."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Where the brave citizens who speak..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the brave citizens who speak out against these injustices are brutally punished for it!"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Where the brave citizens who speak..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the brave citizens who speak out against these injustices are ignored by their own King!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm looking forward to seeing him..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to seeing him suffer."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We in the Rizian People's Party co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We in the Rizian People's Party completely agree that in the absence of a diplomatic solution, the people of Zille should be trusted to decide their own fate."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In the absence of a diplomatic sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the absence of a diplomatic solution, President Wiktor Smolak proposed a democratic referendum on the ownership of Zille. A suggestion that our King opposed."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Rizian People's Party wishes H..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian People's Party wishes His Majesty to reconsider. To have faith that the people of ZIlle will make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cast his gaze around the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: He cast his gaze around the chamber.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In the absence of a diplomatic sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the absence of a diplomatic solution, President Wiktor Smolak proposed a democratic referendum on the ownership of Zille."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Yet we question why those in Zille..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet we question why those in Zille are being granted a right that Rizians themselves are denied."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""After all, why wouldn't they choos..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all, why wouldn't they choose Rizia over the repression of the Smolak regime?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon was sitting off to one..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon was sitting off to one side. The two men locked eyes.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country where those with opposin..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country where those with opposing viewpoints can nonetheless work together to create opportunities for everyone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cast his gaze around the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: He cast his gaze around the chamber.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And it is my hope that they will c..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it is my hope that they will come back to a Rizia that has changed for the better."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country whose King is willing to..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country whose King is willing to make sacrifices -- personal ones -- so that his people may enjoy the freedoms they deserve."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo looked questioningly in my dir..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo looked questioningly in my direction.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty. Your Grace. Madam de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Your Grace. Madam de Rava."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty. Madam de Rava.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Madam de Rava."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We open this session by acknowledg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We open this session by acknowledging the success of the Zille Agreement and the imminent return of Rizia's long-lost territory."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We open this session by acknowledg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We open this session by acknowledging the imminent return of Rizia's long-lost territory. Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates broke into applause."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates broke into applause.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The RPP congratulates His Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RPP congratulates His Majesty on this diplomatic triumph. In a world where might all too often makes right, it is heartening to see the spirit of compromise win the day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze came to land on me. He fla..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze came to land on me. He flashed a knowing smile.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And it is my hope that our long-lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it is my hope that our long-lost brothers and sisters will come back to a Rizia that has changed for the better."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A kingdom that is finally at peace.""
entries.dialogueText: "A kingdom that is finally at peace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze came to land on me."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze came to land on me.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A country hell-bent on the destruc..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country hell-bent on the destruction of democracy, whether within its own borders or abroad in Vendonesam."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How can he speak like this in fron..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can he speak like this in front of me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lies. Slander. All of it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lies. Slander. All of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hmm. I can see why he struck a cho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. I can see why he struck a chord with the commoners."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't react to his words."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't react to his words.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You must be careful, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "You must be careful, Your Majesty. His movement has become dangerously strong."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""His movement has become dangerousl..."
entries.dialogueText: "His movement has become dangerously strong. He knows if you strike him down, it will only become stronger."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I am as shocked as you are to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am as shocked as you are to hear such language in this room."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You're wise not to give his moveme..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're wise not to give his movement more ammunition. They have become dangerously strong."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Still, I'm shocked to hear such la..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I'm shocked to hear such language in this room."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria stood."
entries.dialogueText: Daria stood.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC objects.""
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC objects."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo eyed her coolly, waiting for..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo eyed her coolly, waiting for her to speak.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And we wonder whether, given the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we wonder whether, given the choice, they will opt to return to this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But we are sadly not surprised. Af..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we are sadly not surprised. After all, this is a country ruled by a family that chose to give away an entire region rather than lose power."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Mr. Soletato, His Majesty will agr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Soletato, His Majesty will agree that tirades against the Crown have no place in the House of Delegates."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""When the referendum succeeds, we m..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the referendum succeeds, we must not forget that with our expanded territory comes expanded responsibility."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""What's important is that Zille is..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's important is that Zille is coming back into our fold. We must look to the future and decide how the reintegration of the region will proceed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A chorus of boos came from the RPP..."
entries.dialogueText: A chorus of boos came from the RPP side of the room, nearly drowning her out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon didn't join in. He sat..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon didn't join in. He sat off to the side with his arms folded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""SILENCE!""
entries.dialogueText: "SILENCE!"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We must look to the future. If the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must look to the future. If the Zille referendum succeeds, there is still the question of how the region will be reintegrated."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I am confident the Alliance of Nat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident the Alliance of Nations will restore Zille's ownership to Rizia. We must look to the future and decide how the reintegration of the region will proceed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before anyone could speak, Sal Igna..."
entries.dialogueText: Before anyone could speak, Sal Ignacius slowly walked to the center of the room.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As strong as his movement is, I st..."
entries.dialogueText: "As strong as his movement is, I still find it shocking to hear such language in this room."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked once more at the empty cha..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked once more at the empty chair next to mine. With Hugo resigned, I was talking to myself.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""With the removal of provincial lev..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the removal of provincial levies as well as provincial police forces, Rizia is undergoing a process of centralization. The three royal houses are beginning to unite as one."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""With the removal of provincial pol..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the removal of provincial police forces, Rizia is undergoing a process of centralization. The three royal houses are beginning to unite as one."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""With the removal of provincial lev..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the removal of provincial levies, Rizia is undergoing a process of centralization. The three royal houses are beginning to unite as one."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""To that end, I submit that assigni..."
entries.dialogueText: "To that end, I submit that assigning Zille's governance to one of those houses will be an unwelcome disruption to that unity."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC therefore officially recom..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC therefore officially recommends that the region be governed by Rizia's central authority, akin to the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The majority of House Sazon had no..."
entries.dialogueText: "The majority of House Sazon had nothing to do with what happened in 1926. We have ancestral ties to this land, and we will shepherd its reintegration into Rizia with sensitivity and care."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You may have proven yourself adept..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may have proven yourself adept at leading strikes and protests. But the time has come for constructive solutions rather than accusations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Baroness de Rava, you are no longe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Baroness de Rava, you are no longer House Speaker. Please let Mr. Sotelato proceed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reintegration of Zille is impo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reintegration of Zille is important to me as well. I want to hear where the Delegates stand on it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will consider Zille's reintegra..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will consider Zille's reintegration once we wrest it from Wehlen's hands. For now, what else is on the agenda, Mr. Speaker?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen to me, Mr. Sotelato. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to me, Mr. Sotelato. I will no longer tolerate such disrespect from within my own government."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I mean no disrespect, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I mean no disrespect, Your Majesty, but look around. This government was chosen by the people."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I mean no disrespect, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I mean no disrespect, Your Majesty, but look around. This government was chosen by the people, despite a system designed to work against them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria raised her voice to be heard..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria raised her voice to be heard over the discontented murmurs of Adarfo's followers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria stepped back from the podium..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria stepped back from the podium and forced herself to smile. Adarfo waited a beat before speaking.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Contrary to what Baroness de Rava..."
entries.dialogueText: "Contrary to what Baroness de Rava claims, I did not only come here to complain."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""My party was once content to accep..."
entries.dialogueText: "My party was once content to accept whatever crumbs of acknowledgement we could get from the Crown. Now, we have the strength and the imagination to demand more."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria stepped back from the podium..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria stepped back from the podium and forced herself to smile. Adarfo waited a beat before speaking.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Rizia is wealthier than we ever we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is wealthier than we ever were during the Valero era. We shouldn't be afraid to distribute our resources to the people who need them most."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We're becoming a world leader in n..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're becoming a world leader in natural gas. We should share the profits with those who need them most."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Now that RRG has been nationalized..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that RRG has been nationalized, all of Rizia should share in our gold mining profits."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Rather than pour our resources int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rather than pour our resources into the invasion of Pales, we should be spending them on our people."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We've given stimulus checks to our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've given stimulus checks to our citizens. Why not a monthly base wage, payable to all, that allows them to pursue education and innovation without living in constant fear of poverty?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""There's been talk of giving stimul..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's been talk of giving stimulus checks to Rizian citizens. Why not a monthly base wage, payable to all, that allows them to pursue education and innovation without living in constant fear of poverty?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Our public transport is subsidized..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our public transport is subsidized. Why shouldn't it be entirely free of charge?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Where my predecessor once proposed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where my predecessor once proposed subsidizing public transport, I submit that it should be entirely free of charge."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Increasing funds for health care w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Increasing funds for health care was a good first step, but why do Rizians have to pay for medical treatment at all?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""People on the streets are demandin..."
entries.dialogueText: "People on the streets are demanding affordable health care -- why not make medical treatment free for everyone?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""With Zille returning to Rizia -- t..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Zille returning to Rizia -- to say nothing of Pales -- we will gain millions of new citizens. Let us work together in making sure none of them are left behind."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""They will be rejoining a county wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will be rejoining a county where those with opposing viewpoints can nonetheless work together to create opportunities for everyone."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""With Zille returning to Rizia, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Zille returning to Rizia, we will gain millions of new citizens. Let us work together in making sure none of them are left behind."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is the security threat we've..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the security threat we've been worried about? He seems about as dangerous as one of Ricardus' dogs."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Our nobility is sitting on a mount..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our nobility is sitting on a mountain of wealth that means nothing to them, but that could transform the lives of everyday people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria interrupted in a rush."
entries.dialogueText: Daria interrupted in a rush.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room fell silent. Both Adarfo a..."
entries.dialogueText: The room fell silent. Both Adarfo and Daria looked at me, waiting for me to speak.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sotelato, please proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sotelato, please proceed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What were you saying, Baroness de..."
entries.dialogueText: "What were you saying, Baroness de Rava?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've let this go on for long enoug..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've let this go on for long enough. I have an announcement to make."
entries.menuText: "I've let this go on for long enough. I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down House Of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Hugo shift his posture forwar..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Hugo shift his posture forward. All the Delegates' eyes were on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All the Delegates' eyes were on me."
entries.dialogueText: All the Delegates' eyes were on me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The House of Delegates will cease..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates will cease to operate as a branch of government. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're fired. All of you. You don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're fired. All of you. You don't have to go home, but you can't stay here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A new era for Rizia is beginning...."
entries.dialogueText: "A new era for Rizia is beginning. Faster, more streamlined, less bogged down by dissent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are all unclean. The stain of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are all unclean. The stain of impurity must be washed out of Porte Drazon so that Rizia can be born anew."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room began to fill with disbeli..."
entries.dialogueText: The room began to fill with disbelieving chatter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, his bark is worse than his bi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, his bark is worse than his bite."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Appearances can be deceiving. I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Appearances can be deceiving. I don't trust him one bit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That part about sacrifices... I ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "That part about sacrifices... I have no idea what he meant."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates applauded politely."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates applauded politely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria put up a hand."
entries.dialogueText: Daria put up a hand.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""My colleague in the RPP is missing..."
entries.dialogueText: "My colleague in the RPP is missing one important point. Zille's return is now secured, but its future governance remains undecided. May I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you calling Bruno unthreatenin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you calling Bruno unthreatening?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean? Rico's dogs scar..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean? Rico's dogs scare me to death."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""My colleague in the RPP is missing..."
entries.dialogueText: "My colleague in the RPP is missing one important point. With Zille's return now on the horizon, its future governance remains undecided. May I?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria shuffled some notes around. S..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria shuffled some notes around. She looked at Manus.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And of course, our... esteemed Gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, our... esteemed Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw dejection on most of the Dele..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw dejection on most of the Delegates' faces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon was sitting off to one..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon was sitting off to one side. The two men locked eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon was sitting off to one..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon was sitting off to one side. The two men locked eyes.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Let's put aside the Zille issue fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's put aside the Zille issue for a second and address the elephant in the room. The RPP has evolved."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""My colleague from House Sazon beli..."
entries.dialogueText: "My colleague from House Sazon believes that meaningful change in Rizia can only happen gradually, through compromise with the ruling class."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But he comes from a place of privi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But he comes from a place of privilege. He was voted out of leadership because the majority of Rizians cannot afford to wait. Nor can they compromise."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""My former colleague from House Saz..."
entries.dialogueText: "My former colleague from House Sazon believed that meaningful change in Rizia could only happen gradually, through compromise with the ruling class."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But he came from a place of privil..."
entries.dialogueText: "But he came from a place of privilege. The majority of Rizians cannot afford to wait. Nor can they compromise."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""My party was once content to accep..."
entries.dialogueText: "My party was once content to accept whatever crumbs of acknowledgement we could get from the Crown. I say we should not let our opposition status limit our imagination."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""This is childish, Mr. Sotelato. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is childish, Mr. Sotelato. A Malenyevist pipe dream."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Rizia has had a strong welfare sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has had a strong welfare state since the days of Queen Lyza. The King has strengthened it further, at great cost to the Crown. What more would you ask of him?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Rizia has had a strong welfare sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has had a strong welfare state since the days of Queen Lyza. The King has maintained it. What more would you ask of him?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You claim you want to empower the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You claim you want to empower the Rizian people, then insist the Crown coddle them as if they were incapable of meeting their own needs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sotelato has relayed his const..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sotelato has relayed his constituency's demands. I am under no obligation to meet them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A good point. What's next, a propo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A good point. What's next, a proposal that I personally wipe our citizens' bottoms when they visit the toilet?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo stifled a laugh. Adarfo straig..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo stifled a laugh. Adarfo straightened up in indignation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo straightened up in indignati..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo straightened up in indignation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe the RPP speaker's propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe the RPP speaker's proposals are entirely reasonable. However, implementing them all at once will put a strain on our resources.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our people will be empowered to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our people will be empowered to do great things once their basic needs are met. Mr. Sotelato is on the right track."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo nodded modestly."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo nodded modestly.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We are not expecting that. Only th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not expecting that. Only that our King look beyond the horizons of tradition and recognize what is possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. Our economy will suffer if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Our economy will suffer if our populace expects to receive everything for free."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Rizians are willing to pay taxes f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizians are willing to pay taxes for these services. It's a better use for them than subsidizing the Royal Family's lifestyle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is true, Mr. Sotelato. I myse..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is true, Mr. Sotelato. I myself have had everything in life handed to me, and look at me now. I'm useless."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo heaved a deep sigh."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo heaved a deep sigh.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""No obligation from the law. But ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "No obligation from the law. But how long can you ignore the pressure from your own populace?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""No, of course not. But such extrem..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, of course not. But such extreme ideas belong in the pages of a diary, not houses of government."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was accompanied by a group of me..."
entries.dialogueText: He was accompanied by a group of men in blindingly white uniforms, their collars decorated with six stars. The tallest of them stepped forward and bowed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria bowed as she approached the p..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria bowed as she approached the podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo merely lowered his head. The..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo merely lowered his head. The new RPP leader wasn't wearing a sash or even a tie. He had a harshness to his features that made him seem older than his years.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus followed suit, smiling confid..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus followed suit, smiling confidently as he straightened up.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Good afternoon, everyone.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, everyone."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And of course, our... esteemed Gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, our... esteemed Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Your Majesty. Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""And of course, our esteemed Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, our esteemed Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We open this session with the ackn..."
entries.dialogueText: "We open this session with the acknowledgement that our attempts to negotiate the return of the Zille region have, regrettably, not borne fruit."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw dejection on most of the Dele..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw dejection on most of the Delegates' faces.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We in the Rizian People's Party co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We in the Rizian People's Party completely agree that in the absence of a diplomatic solution, the people of Zille should have the right to choose their own fate."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cast his gaze around the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: He cast his gaze around the chamber.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""In the absence of a diplomatic sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the absence of a diplomatic solution, President Wiktor Smolak proposed a democratic referendum on the ownership of Zille."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And we look forward to seeing that..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we look forward to seeing that very same right extended to all Rizians. One day."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""In the absence of a diplomatic sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the absence of a diplomatic solution, President Wiktor Smolak proposed a democratic referendum on the ownership of Zille. A suggestion that His Majesty opposed."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The Rizian People's Party wishes H..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian People's Party wishes His Majesty to reconsider, and to place his faith in the people of Zille to make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cast his gaze around the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: He cast his gaze around the chamber.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""After all... every person, regardl..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all... every person, regardless of status, has the right to decide their own fate."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Furthermore, we in the RNC wonder..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, we in the RNC wonder whether the Sazons deserve to be granted more territory."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Seriously, Madam Speaker? It's bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seriously, Madam Speaker? It's been almost 30 years."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That may be a long time for a youn..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be a long time for a young man such as yourself, but not for those who remember the bloodshed of 1926."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""In the absence of their heir, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the absence of their heir, the family's once-considerable influence has begun to wane."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Even with Duchess Angelica at the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even with Duchess Angelica at the helm in Iza, the family remains in a weakened state."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Even with Duchess Angelica back on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even with Duchess Angelica back on the Rizian mainland, the family remains in a weakened state."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Duchess Angelica has had Iza resto..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Angelica has had Iza restored to her. Your family should be content with that."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Duchess Angelica has had her forme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Angelica has had her former status restored to her. Your family should be content with that."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Duchess Angelica remains in exile..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Angelica remains in exile -- rightly so. Her niece Leona of Sallabes is still unproven as a leader."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You were allowed out of exile. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were allowed out of exile. Your family should be content with that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo looked at her in disgust."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo looked at her in disgust.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I will add that Zille still suffer..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will add that Zille still suffers the scars of Wehlen's civil war. Its reconstruction must be overseen with the full strength of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You act as if you yourself have no..."
entries.dialogueText: "You act as if you yourself have no conflict of interest. Controlling Zille from Rizia Imperii will make it easier for you to place your own family in charge of its reconstruction."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your intentions are transparent, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your intentions are transparent, Ms. de Rava. Zille isn't even ours yet, and you're scheming about how to use its reconstruction to enrich your own family."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your intentions are transparent, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your intentions are transparent, Ms. de Rava. You care less about the well-being of the people of Zille than about using its reconstruction to enrich your own family."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Sazons are not entitled to thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons are not entitled to this land by birthright alone. But I do believe their years of stewardship of Zille should be recognized in some way, if only symbolically."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Sazons are not entitled to thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons are not entitled to this land by birthright alone. Neither are any members of the nobility."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Delegate from Brenas is speaki..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Delegate from Brenas is speaking out of turn."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In the RPP's view, the details of..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the RPP's view, the details of Zille's governance are less important than ensuring that these new Rizians -- and *all* Rizians, for that matter -- are treated with fairness and respect."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""If we can't do that, Zille might a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can't do that, Zille might as well remain Wehzek."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. And what does your 'gov..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. And what does your 'government' wish to accomplish, besides whining?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I was getting to that, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was getting to that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. The real people of Rizia want..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. The real people of Rizia want to be ruled by their King, not a Malenyevist plant."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Rizia's provincial system has serv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's provincial system has served it well in the past. But at a time when national unity is paramount, we should not let the conflicting interests of the three royal houses divide us."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""By all means.""
entries.dialogueText: "By all means."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""There has been talk in these chamb..."
entries.dialogueText: "There has been talk in these chambers of reintegrating Zille into Brenas, thereby placing it under the rule of House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The RNC delegates, as well as some..."
entries.dialogueText: The RNC delegates, as well as some from the RPP side of the room, started jeering. Adarfo banged a gavel.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But we must ask ourselves. What ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we must ask ourselves. What kind of country are we welcoming them back to?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria looked at him skeptically."
entries.dialogueText: Daria looked at him skeptically.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A country where all citizens enjoy..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country where all citizens enjoy the same high quality of life."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A burgeoning world power that has..."
entries.dialogueText: "A burgeoning world power that has finally taken its deserved place on the global stage."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The House of Delegates has ceased..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates has ceased to fulfill its original purpose. It has become infiltrated by foreign provocateurs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank everyone in this room for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank everyone in this room for their years of service to this kingdom. However, I have decided to take our government in a new direction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In times of war, emergency measure..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of war, emergency measures are called for. The monarch of Rizia must be allowed to take swift, decisive action, second-guessed by no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From this day forth, I and my coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "From this day forth, I and my council shall be the sole ruling authority in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This grand experiment has come to..."
entries.dialogueText: "This grand experiment has come to an end. Thank you and farewell."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A deafening crack echoed through th..."
entries.dialogueText: A deafening crack echoed through the chamber as Adarfo slammed his gavel on his podium.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I expected nothing less from you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expected nothing less from you, King Romus."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We will tear it down. Brick by bri..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will tear it down. Brick by brick. With our bare hands."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He whipped around and walked down t..."
entries.dialogueText: He whipped around and walked down the aisle towards the exit. The other members of the RPP followed suit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon was the last to leave...."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon was the last to leave. He hesitated in the doorway for a moment, a pained look on his face, before turning and following his colleagues out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria remained frozen to her podium..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria remained frozen to her podium. Her voice was higher than usual when she spoke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chamber broke out into all-out..."
entries.dialogueText: The chamber broke out into all-out pandemonium. Someone from the RPP shouted, "The King's gone mad!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo worriedly whispered into my ea..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo worriedly whispered into my ear.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty, I had no idea this w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I had no idea this was your intention. Had I known, I--"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty, I know this was your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I know this was your intention, but --"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A deafening crack cut through the n..."
entries.dialogueText: A deafening crack cut through the noise as Daria slammed her gavel on his podium.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We have no choice but to obey His..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have no choice but to obey His Majesty's wishes. The House of Delegates shall be dissolved."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked around the now-silent ro..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked around the now-silent room, as if daring anyone to object again.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It has been an honor serving you a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been an honor serving you and your father, King Romus. I... thank you for the opportunity."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As His Majesty commands, so it sha..."
entries.dialogueText: "As His Majesty commands, so it shall be! Halaita!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""No!""
entries.dialogueText: "No!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon's shout echoed through..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon's shout echoed through the chamber.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, this is an affront t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, this is an affront to your father's legacy and to your own. With this one order, you are erasing decades of progress."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And for what? You already hold nea..."
entries.dialogueText: "And for what? You already hold near-absolute power!"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Don't you see, Mr. Sazon? This sha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you see, Mr. Sazon? This sham of an institution was never going to bring about real progress."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Our king's tools cannot dismantle..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our king's tools cannot dismantle the prison he has built for us. We must tear it down, brick by brick, with our bare hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not forget everything you'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not forget everything you've done for our kingdom, Baroness. Your service will be richly rewarded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may leave now.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may leave now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bowed her head."
entries.dialogueText: She bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you understand this has not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you understand this has nothing to do with you. I was facing extenuating circumstances and had to act accordingly."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Yes, Your Majesty. I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. I know."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Y-yes, Your Majesty. Right away.""
entries.dialogueText: "Y-yes, Your Majesty. Right away."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That would be most kind of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That would be most kind of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There may be a spot on my council..."
entries.dialogueText: "There may be a spot on my council for a talented civil servant such as yourself. When the time comes, do not hesitate to petition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bowed her head."
entries.dialogueText: She bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I won't forget your kind words, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't forget your kind words, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His colleague walked up to him and..."
entries.dialogueText: His colleague walked up to him and roughly grabbed him by the shoulder.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""This so-called institution was a f..."
entries.dialogueText: "This so-called institution was a fraud from the start. Our king's tools will never dismantle the prison he has built for us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned abruptly and walked down..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned abruptly and walked down the aisle, motioning for Manus to join him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment's hesitation, Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment's hesitation, Manus started walking towards the exit as well. The rest of the members of the RPP followed suit.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Can't you see, Ms. de Rava? This i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't you see, Ms. de Rava? This is an affront to King Valero's legacy. To your own, as House Speaker!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizia is descending into totalism...."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is descending into totalism. The people will not stand for this."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The people will trust in their Kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people will trust in their King to guide the country with the same wisdom he always has, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Then *I* will not stand for this...."
entries.dialogueText: "Then *I* will not stand for this. I weep for the future of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He abruptly turned and began walkin..."
entries.dialogueText: He abruptly turned and began walking down the aisle towards the exit. The other RPP members followed him out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As if in a daze, she stepped away f..."
entries.dialogueText: As if in a daze, she stepped away from the podium and walked towards the chamber doors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal approached and stood behind the..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal approached and stood behind the empty Grand Vizier's seat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rusty Montoro has connections thro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty Montoro has connections throughout the capital. He'll help soften the blow."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It begins, Your Majesty. Well done.""
entries.dialogueText: "It begins, Your Majesty. Well done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and I watched the remaining memb..."
entries.dialogueText: He and I watched the remaining members of the RNC file out, one by one, until the House of Delegates was completely empty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alone on my throne, I watched the r..."
entries.dialogueText: Alone on my throne, I watched the remaining members of the RNC file out, one by one, until the House of Delegates was completely empty.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is bound to reflect badly on..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is bound to reflect badly on the Crown, Your Majesty. I hope you are prepared for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord is on our side, Hugo. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord is on our side, Hugo. We will not fail."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought about my last conversatio..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought about my last conversation with Rusty Montoro. His connections would help soften this blow -- to some extent.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius approached a..."
entries.dialogueText: Grand Wiseman Ignacius approached and stood behind Hugo's seat.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It begins, Your Majesty. Well done.""
entries.dialogueText: "It begins, Your Majesty. Well done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The three of us watched the remaini..."
entries.dialogueText: The three of us watched the remaining members of the RNC file out, one by one, until the House of Delegates was completely empty.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Grand Wiseman too, I presume.""
entries.dialogueText: "The Grand Wiseman too, I presume."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have my own connections within t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have my own connections within the Rizian National Coalition. I'll smooth things over with them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But as for the others... you're pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as for the others... you're playing with fire, Romus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and I watched the remaining memb..."
entries.dialogueText: He and I watched the remaining members of the RNC file out, one by one, until the House of Delegates was completely empty.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The House of Delegates was a failu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates was a failure, Hugo. Everyone in Rizia will agree."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What choice did I have? Sit here a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What choice did I have? Sit here and let Porte Drazon turn into a hotbed of dissent?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The nobles who held seats in the R..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobles who held seats in the RNC won't be happy. But I'll try to smooth things over with them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No, you are right. I'm sure it's b..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, you are right. I'm sure it's better this way."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""They will come to see the light.""
entries.dialogueText: "They will come to see the light."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But without a forum to express pub..."
entries.dialogueText: "But without a forum to express public opinion, you will be deaf to the needs of your people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Delegates were impeding my vis..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Delegates were impeding my vision for Rizia. They had to go."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps you are right. It's better..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you are right. It's better this way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""After all, if Wehlen looks like a..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all, if Wehlen looks like a paragon of freedom next to us, we know we have a problem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are wrong in your insinuation..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are wrong in your insinuation that Rizians lack freedom. You yourself are free to leave this room anytime you like."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well said, Mr. Sazon. Freedom is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well said, Mr. Sazon. Freedom is paramount."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few people on the RNC side of the..."
entries.dialogueText: A few people on the RNC side of the room laughed. Daria took the opportunity to cut in.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lofty words, Mr. Sazon, but I hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lofty words, Mr. Sazon, but I hear no concrete recommendations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the podium next to his, Daria lo..."
entries.dialogueText: At the podium next to his, Daria looked less than impressed.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Nice words, Mr. Sazon, but we have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nice words, Mr. Sazon, but we have a practical issue to address."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I do. There is a practical issue t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do. There is a practical issue that the House Speaker has not yet touched upon."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty, but ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty, but there is a practical issue that the House Speaker has not yet touched upon."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Precisely, Your Majesty. There is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely, Your Majesty. There is a practical issue that the House Speaker has not yet touched on."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Now that Zille's return has been s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that Zille's return has been secured, its governance must be decided upon."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""With Zille's return now on the hor..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Zille's return now on the horizon, its governance must be decided upon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus made an offended noise."
entries.dialogueText: Manus made an offended noise.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I didn't add that to the agenda be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't add that to the agenda because I didn't believe it worthy of debate."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""By your own House, you mean. Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By your own House, you mean. Your Majesty, the RNC has prepared an opinion on this topic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go on, then. Let's hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go on, then. Let's hear it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked down at her notes."
entries.dialogueText: She looked down at her notes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Baroness de Rava, but y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Baroness de Rava, but your opinion is not necessary. I will make up my own mind on Zille in due time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille isn't even back in our hands..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille isn't even back in our hands yet, and you two are already squabbling over it? There are more important things to discuss."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may proceed. Keeping in mind I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may proceed. Keeping in mind I am not obligated to side with either one of you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, of course. I know you will ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course. I know you will choose wisely."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""By that logic, I suppose Pales sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "By that logic, I suppose Pales should go to House Azaro when it is reconquered? Creating what we can all agree is an imbalance of strength between the three provinces..."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The King has indicated, and I agre..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King has indicated, and I agree, that Brenas, Cardesse-Montaklar and Valenqiris should answer to the Crown before anyone else."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""In my view, no single family -- Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "In my view, no single family -- House Toras included -- should hold enough power to defy the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Baroness De Rava has spoken wisely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Baroness De Rava has spoken wisely. Everyone in this room should remember that the King's decisions supercede all others."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody said anything."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody said anything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Correct. The Crown is answerable t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Correct. The Crown is answerable to no one but God."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From his seat, Sal gave a nod of sa..."
entries.dialogueText: From his seat, Sal gave a nod of satisfaction.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All three of Rizia's royal houses..."
entries.dialogueText: "All three of Rizia's royal houses are an integral part of our history and tradition, and should be recognized as such."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beside me, Hugo gave a nod of appro..."
entries.dialogueText: Beside me, Hugo gave a nod of approval.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you are saying no checks and ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are saying no checks and balances should be placed on the monarch's power, then I disagree."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard murmurs of agreement from t..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard murmurs of agreement from the RPP side of the room.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We pay income tax, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We pay income tax, Your Majesty. Is it too much to ask that our money go towards our communities, rather than your daughter's wedding cake?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Manus blush."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Manus blush.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We pay income tax, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We pay income tax, Your Majesty. Is it too much to ask that our money go towards our communities, rather than subsidizing the Royal Family's lifestyle?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's the last straw, Mr. Sotelat..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the last straw, Mr. Sotelato. I have an announcement to make."
entries.menuText: "That's the last straw, Mr. Sotelato. I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, I disagree that Mr. Sotel..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I disagree that Mr. Sotelato knows better than his King on matters of citizen welfare.  I therefore have an announcement to make."
entries.menuText: "However, I disagree that Mr. Sotelato knows better than his King on matters of citizen welfare.  I therefore have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do recognize what is possible. J..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do recognize what is possible. Just as I recognize that I alone must take the reins on citizen welfare. I have an announcement to make."
entries.menuText: "I do recognize what is possible. Just as I recognize that I alone must take the reins on citizen welfare. I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Ahem. Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ahem. Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On that very subject... I have an..."
entries.dialogueText: "On that very subject... I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House Of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria turned a page in her binder."
entries.dialogueText: Daria turned a page in her binder.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your input, Madam Sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your input, Madam Speaker, but it is time to move on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Daria nodded.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Even if only symbolically.""
entries.dialogueText: "Even if only symbolically."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I am saying the primary allegiance..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am saying the primary allegiance of the people of Rizia should be to their King and his government. Not their Duke or Duchess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how do you propose the Crown i..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how do you propose the Crown improve the lives of Rizians, Mr. Speaker? Besides what we have already done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spoke calmly."
entries.dialogueText: He spoke calmly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are speaking as if Rizians liv..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are speaking as if Rizians live in misery. The people of our kingdom have never been happier."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Only by the good graces of a King..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only by the good graces of a King they did not choose."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your input on this...."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your input on this. It is valuable to have an opinion from a non-noble."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You are speaking out of turn, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "You are speaking out of turn, Mr. Sotelato. The point I wanted to make is this."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We will have the same decision to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will have the same decision to make when Pales is reconquered."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We have seen the strife that resul..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have seen the strife that results when Rizia's noble families go up against each other."
