entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there anything else the Delegat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there anything else the Delegates want to bring up before today's session ends?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo looked up at me with barely..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo looked up at me with barely constrained anger.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""People are suffering under the mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "People are suffering under the monarchy, and you talk about decorum."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""This was me being polite, *Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was me being polite, *Your Majesty*. See where it got me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo whipped around and walked do..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo whipped around and walked down the aisle towards the exit. The other members of the RPP followed suit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon was the last to leave...."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon was the last to leave. He hesitated in the doorway for a moment, a pained look on his face, before turning and following his colleagues out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will resume this conversation w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will resume this conversation when the time comes for Wehlen to hand Zille back. For now, are there any other topics on the agenda?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Certainly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The kind of systemic transformatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "The kind of systemic transformation that Rizia needs will not happen overnight, it's true. But in the meantime, there are things we can do to make an immediate, tangible difference in people's lives."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""If the monarchy wants to stay in p..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the monarchy wants to stay in power, it should use its decree powers to make real, tangible differences in people's lives."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The fact that you regard these sim..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that you regard these simple measures as extreme makes me fear for a future under the RNC."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will speak more about this. I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will speak more about this. I am looking forward to working with the 'evolved' RPP."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's teeth were clenched."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's teeth were clenched.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria spoke through gritted teeth."
entries.dialogueText: Daria spoke through gritted teeth.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC will think about your idea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC will think about your ideas as well, Mr. Sotelato."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Very well. But I hope you will kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. But I hope you will keep the recommendation regarding Zille in mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you both for your opinions r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you both for your opinions regarding Zille. Now, let's move on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have to sit here and toler..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have to sit here and tolerate this. I'm calling an end to today's session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot promise anything. But sen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot promise anything. But send me your proposals."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I will. Right away.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will. Right away."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw disbelieving looks on both Hu..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw disbelieving looks on both Hugo and Daria's faces.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't come here to listen to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't come here to listen to you two squabble over Zille. There are more important things to discuss."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Agreed, Your Majesty. Ms. De Rava,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed, Your Majesty. Ms. De Rava, let's shelve this conversation."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""One moment. Your Majesty, this is..."
entries.dialogueText: "One moment. Your Majesty, this is not only about Zille."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You have already introduced centra..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have already introduced centralization measures to the provinces. You must agree that Brenas, Cardesse-Montaklar and Valenqiris should answer to the Crown before anyone else."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We will have the same decision to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will have the same decision to make when Pales is reconquered. Will the spoils of war go to Rizia as a whole, or will they enrich House Azaro?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Rizia's three royal houses have co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's three royal houses have contributed so much to this kingdom, yet their internal conflicts have nearly torn us apart."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The provinces command their own ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The provinces command their own armies and police forces. Grant them too much power, and they might use it to defy the Crown."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Nobody is going to defy the Crown...."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody is going to defy the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The provinces do answer to the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: "The provinces do answer to the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And with the merging of House Tora..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with the merging of House Toras and House Sazon, two of the three houses will be united anyway."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""When Zille rejoins us -- to say no..."
entries.dialogueText: "When Zille rejoins us -- to say nothing of Pales -- we will gain millions of new citizens. How do we make sure nobody is left behind?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""When Zille rejoins us, we will gai..."
entries.dialogueText: "When Zille rejoins us, we will gain millions of new citizens. How do we make sure nobody is left behind?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The hand of God will bring us toge..."
entries.dialogueText: "The hand of God will bring us together. Our devotion to Wruhecism will unite and uplift us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You tell me, Mr. Sazon. How?""
entries.dialogueText: "You tell me, Mr. Sazon. How?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Nobody is going to defy the Crown...."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody is going to defy the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The provinces do answer to the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: "The provinces do answer to the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This session has been a waste of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "This session has been a waste of time so far. What else is on the docket?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am surprised to hear you of all..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am surprised to hear you of all people arguing on behalf of noble privilege."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm not asking for special privile..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not asking for special privileges as a Sazon. All I'm requesting is that our connection to Zille should be recognized."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Certainly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I am truly sorry, Your Majesty. Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly sorry, Your Majesty. Moving on..."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Moving on...""
entries.dialogueText: "Moving on..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are the head of parliament, Ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are the head of parliament, Baroness de Rava. Stay out of Royal House politics."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I-- certainly.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- certainly."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Our win in Operation Golden Shield..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our win in Operation Golden Shield provided a considerable boost to national unity. However, the war is still ongoing, and we must find ways to keep morale up."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Our loss in Operation Golden Shiel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our loss in Operation Golden Shield was a considerable blow to national unity. We must find ways to keep morale up."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The news of the King's success wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "The news of the King's success with Zille has provided a considerable boost to national unity. But I believe more can be done."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The prolonged delay of Zille's ret..."
entries.dialogueText: "The prolonged delay of Zille's return has been a detriment to national unity. We must find ways to keep morale up."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She cast a look at Adarfo."
entries.dialogueText: She cast a look at Adarfo.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Especially in light of the forces..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially in light of the forces that seek to divide us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She cast a look at Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She cast a look at Manus.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC has heard the calls for re..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC has heard the calls for reform, whether from the streets or from within these very walls."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""But we are convinced this is not t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we are convinced this is not the right way forward."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She held her head high."
entries.dialogueText: She held her head high.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""In recent years, it has become fas..."
entries.dialogueText: "In recent years, it has become fashionable to promote democracy as a salve for all of society's ills."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""In the RNC's opinion, Rizia has ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the RNC's opinion, Rizia has exactly as much democracy as it needs. Our King may act on the public's demands if he so chooses, but he is not subservient to them."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Demonstrators come and go. We shou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Demonstrators come and go. We should not betray the ideals of our forebears just because a handful of voices are yelling at us to do so."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A handful? You have no idea how la..."
entries.dialogueText: "A handful? You have no idea how large our movement is."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Of course, all of Rizia will come..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, all of Rizia will come together to celebrate Princess Vina's wedding."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""And, with any luck, our reunion wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And, with any luck, our reunion with Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled thinly at Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled thinly at Manus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""But perhaps we should find a way t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But perhaps we should find a way to extend Her Highness' good fortune to all citizens. A show of royal largesse."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's more than just a handful, Ms...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's more than just a handful, Ms. de Rava, and you know it."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Big or small, this 'movement' is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Big or small, this 'movement' is a mere hiccup compared to the centuries-long tradition of the monarchy."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Normally the RNC does not recommen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Normally the RNC does not recommend grandiose gestures. But in this case, I suggest we remind the dissenters how good life under the Rizian monarchy can be."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""For that matter... what about auto..."
entries.dialogueText: "For that matter... what about automobiles?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We can use our windfall from the A..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can use our windfall from the Aureus gas field to provide free fuel to every citizen."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC suggests a show of largess..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC suggests a show of largesse. The kind of gesture only a proud monarchy is capable of."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Imagine if every Rizian household..."
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine if every Rizian household had a car provided to them by the Crown. Perhaps even with His Majesty's face painted on it."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I've said all I need to say, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've said all I need to say, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few final formalities, the..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few final formalities, the House of Delegates session disbanded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A look of disbelief was frozen on D..."
entries.dialogueText: A look of disbelief was frozen on Daria's face.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Not just valuable -- crucial. We a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not just valuable -- crucial. We are the majority, after all."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""It's especially galling that the a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's especially galling that the actual work will be done by disenfranchised labor hands, while the de Ravas rake in the rewards."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""It's especially galling that the a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's especially galling that the actual work will be done by disenfranchised commoners while the de Ravas rake in the rewards."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""In times of strife, a grand gestur..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of strife, a grand gesture from the King may indeed boost national unity."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""But only if it comes as a gift fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "But only if it comes as a gift from the monarch, not a sop to reformists."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me with piercing eyes."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me with piercing eyes.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Unless the Grand Wiseman has anyth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unless the Grand Wiseman has anything to add."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I've said all I need to say, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've said all I need to say, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I have heard the people cry out fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have heard the people cry out for help, the same as you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal clasped his hands together."
entries.dialogueText: Sal clasped his hands together.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By God and the King's good graces,..."
entries.dialogueText: "By God and the King's good graces, they shall be uplifted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can tell you're new to politics...."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell you're new to politics. Trust me when I say you'll get a lot further with honey than vinegar."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I will not apologize for filling m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not apologize for filling my role as a conduit of public opinion."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But thank you for the advice.""
entries.dialogueText: "But thank you for the advice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will be the judge of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will be the judge of that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But only if they are pure of heart..."
entries.dialogueText: "But only if they are pure of heart and have not sinned."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Give it some thought. Before it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give it some thought. Before it's too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By uniting everyone under the bann..."
entries.dialogueText: "By uniting everyone under the banner of the Rizian monarchy, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The state will provide for them, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The state will provide for them, as we always have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We won't have to worry about that...."
entries.dialogueText: "We won't have to worry about that. Rizia is paradise compared to Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, that... But not only.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that... But not only."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But we could be better.""
entries.dialogueText: "But we could be better."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""At the very minimum, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "At the very minimum, yes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizia is evolving, Your Majesty. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is evolving, Your Majesty. We must have the courage to evolve with it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You have heard the growing call fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have heard the growing call for reform. Perhaps you are even planning to respond in some way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You have heard the call for reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have heard the call for reform. With the RPP leading parliament, it is too loud to ignore."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me cautiously."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me cautiously.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The sweeping changes that they dem..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sweeping changes that they demand will take time. But meanwhile, the Crown has the capability to make a real difference in commoners' lives."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizia is wealthier than we ever we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is wealthier than we ever were during the Valero era. We shouldn't be afraid to distribute our resources to the people who need them most."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We're becoming a world leader in n..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're becoming a world leader in natural gas. We should share the profits with those who need them most."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Now that RRG has been nationalized..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that RRG has been nationalized, all of Rizia should share in our gold mining profits."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We may not have the resources to d..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may not have the resources to do so right at this moment. But if you'll permit me a flight of fancy..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rather than pour our resources int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rather than pour our resources into the invasion of Pales, we should be spending them on our people."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our energy surplus is the envy of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our energy surplus is the envy of Merkopa. We could use it to cover electricity costs for every household in the country..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We are not asking for that. Only s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not asking for that. Only some measure of recognition."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""People on the streets are demandin..."
entries.dialogueText: "People on the streets are demanding affordable health care -- I agree that this will save our government millions in the long run."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our public transport is subsidized..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our public transport is subsidized. Why shouldn't it be entirely free of charge?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If we subsidize public transit, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we subsidize public transit, we'll reduce car traffic and relieve commuters' economic stress in one fell swoop."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Increasing funds for health care w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Increasing funds for health care was a good first step, but why do Rizians have to pay for medical treatment at all?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why not go further? We could insti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why not go further? We could institute a monthly base wage that frees all Rizians from the fear of poverty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's next, a proposal that I per..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's next, a proposal that I personally wipe our citizens' bottoms when they visit the toilet?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very reasonable proposals. However..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very reasonable proposals. However, I worry implementing them all at once will put a strain our resources.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizian living standards are better..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian living standards are better than ever before. I see no need to gild the lily."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo stifled a laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo stifled a laugh.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizians are willing to pay taxes f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizians are willing to pay taxes for these services, Your Majesty. It was not our idea that they be removed."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizians pay income tax, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizians pay income tax, Your Majesty. They should see that money invested back into their communities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good thinking. That way, everyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good thinking. That way, everyone will know how generous their king is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are asking for too much. Besid..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are asking for too much. Besides, handouts are no way to improve living standards."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC strongly objects to such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC strongly objects to such an idea, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The RNC strongly objects to such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC strongly objects to such an idea, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Ah... yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah... yes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Public approval of the Crown has c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Public approval of the Crown has continued to drop since the loss of Golden Shield. If you want to save face, such actions may be necessary."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The Crown's public approval rating..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown's public approval ratings are plummeting. If you want to save face, such actions may be necessary."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The public is on your side. Action..."
entries.dialogueText: "The public is on your side. Actions such as these will buoy support for you even further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your words and your proposals will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your words and your proposals will be taken into consideration."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is the RNC's opinion, Barones..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is the RNC's opinion, Baroness de Rava?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, we are of the opinion that Rizia does more than enough for its citizens."

entries.dialogueText: "I have entertained your ramblings for long enough. I have an announcement to make."
entries.menuText: "I have entertained your ramblings for long enough. I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you make of all this, Gran..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you make of all this, Grand Wiseman?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal cleared his throat a few times."
entries.dialogueText: Sal cleared his throat a few times.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Our opinion is that the welfare tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our opinion is that the welfare traditions of Queen Lyza were strong enough."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Having said that, a one-time show..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that, a one-time show of largesse from the Crown could provide a much-needed boost to national unity."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your Majesty, it is the Crown's mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, it is the Crown's moral responsibility to provide for those who are most in need. "

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But I do worry that some sense of..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I do worry that some sense of compassion among the populace is lost when charity becomes the duty of the government and not the individual."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""And to extend such measures to all..."
entries.dialogueText: "And to extend such measures to all citizens, regardless of religion, risks rewarding heathens and nonbelievers--"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""'Rewarding'? All Rizians have the..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Rewarding'? All Rizians have the right to a high quality of life, not only the Wruhecist faithful."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""A one-time show of largesse from t..."
entries.dialogueText: "A one-time show of largesse from the Crown could boost national unity, but we hardly need that."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We're already putting on a royal w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're already putting on a royal wedding, after all."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""But so will the royal wedding.""
entries.dialogueText: "But so will the royal wedding."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled thinly at Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled thinly at Manus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""In the end, Ms. de Rava, we cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, Ms. de Rava, we cannot bribe our way into national unity. We can only achieve that by empowering our citizens."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, that particular measure sound..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that particular measure sounds too extreme to succeed. But if the Crown does pass such a decree, the RPP will support its implementation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled insincerely."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled insincerely.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is changing, Mr. Sazon. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is changing, Mr. Sazon. You must accept that a closer connection to Wruhecism is what the public wants."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is changing, Mr. Sazon. To t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is changing, Mr. Sazon. To that end, I have an announcement to make."

entries.dialogueText: "I agree, Grand Wiseman. We uplift everyone, or no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If non-Wruhecists don't like it, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If non-Wruhecists don't like it, they can go back to where they came from."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gasps and scattered boos rippled th..."
entries.dialogueText: Gasps and scattered boos rippled through the crowd of Delegates. Manus banged a gavel.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""If you believe that is best. Perha..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you believe that is best. Perhaps they will see the light in time."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Is it? The RPP begs to differ.""
entries.dialogueText: "Is it? The RPP begs to differ."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Trust me when I say that you are o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me when I say that you are on the right side of history."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I promise this will earn you your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise this will earn you your people's gratitude."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But I don't have to tell you that,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I don't have to tell you that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""There is only so long you can igno..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is only so long you can ignore our movement, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What our base wants is to be treat..."
entries.dialogueText: "What our base wants is to be treated with fairness and dignity. To have the same rights that citizens of Western countries take for granted."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I believe that's everything the RP..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe that's everything the RPP wanted to cover today. I suggest we adjourn."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Wruhecist or otherwise, our base w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhecist or otherwise, our base wants is to be treated with fairness and dignity. To have the same rights that citizens of Western countries take for granted."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I hope one day you will come to se..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope one day you will come to see it our way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If that's all, Mr. Sazon, I propose we adjourn."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sympathetic to your party's w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sympathetic to your party's wishes, Mr. Sazon. But I must consider all sides."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""What better way to put our new ste..."
entries.dialogueText: "What better way to put our new steelmaking industry to work?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""In addition to providing millions..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition to providing millions with reliable transportation, this would signal to the world that Rizia is looking towards the future -- when cars will no longer be luxuries, but necessities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That sounds preposterously expensi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds preposterously expensive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does the leader of the RPP th..."
entries.dialogueText: "What does the leader of the RPP think about this idea?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, Grand Wiseman Ignacius? Are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Grand Wiseman Ignacius? Are automobiles the future?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""King's Cars. I like it.""
entries.dialogueText: "King's Cars. I like it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal nodded solemnly."
entries.dialogueText: Sal nodded solemnly.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""St. Wruhec walked far and wide to..."
entries.dialogueText: "St. Wruhec walked far and wide to spread his knowledge to his disciples. Had a faster means of transport been available, I am sure he would have used it."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Aside from concerns about traffic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from concerns about traffic and air pollution... I think we should ask ourselves who is making these 'free' cars, and whether this is really what they want."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The RNC is trying to put a gauze b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC is trying to put a gauze bandage on a gaping wound. It won't work."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I think Rizia has a perfectly fine..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think Rizia has a perfectly fine public transit system. I use it myself, in fact."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If we have the means to do so, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we have the means to do so, we should make public transportation free, not automobiles."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I think we should fix our overcrow..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we should fix our overcrowded public transportation system before we begin talking about cars and fuel."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Creating more traffic and more pol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Creating more traffic and more pollution will only add to the existing problems in this country."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. I thought..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I thought you might."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That may be so. But cementing the..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be so. But cementing the loyalty of your people will be worth it."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""What loyalty? Madam Speaker is try..."
entries.dialogueText: "What loyalty? Madam Speaker is trying to put a gauze bandage on a gaping wound."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You are both trying to put a gauze..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are both trying to put a gauze bandage on a gaping wound."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Automobiles are not the future, Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Automobiles are not the future, Madam Speaker. I would rather concentrate our resources on public transit."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Either way, you are putting a gauz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Either way, you are putting a gauze bandage on a gaping wound."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We can see through the RNC's bribe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can see through the RNC's bribery schemes. You're going to have to try harder than that."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As an avid user of public transpor..."
entries.dialogueText: "As an avid user of public transportation myself, I agree."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I would like to point out that if..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to point out that if we put those same resources into public transit, we could move millions more people far more effectively."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have let the 'new' RPP derail th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have let the 'new' RPP derail this session for the last time. I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down House of Delegates]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's true. We have a long way to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. We have a long way to go before we can even think about this proposal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That does not entitle you to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "That does not entitle you to make demands of your King like a bunch of petulant teenagers."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Forgive me if I came across as imp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me if I came across as impolite. I will try to moderate my tone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the entrance to the hall, an aid..."
entries.dialogueText: At the entrance to the hall, an aide I didn't recognize bumped into me, apologized profusely, and sped off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I sat, something crinkled in my..."
entries.dialogueText: As I sat, something crinkled in my suit pocket. I reached in and pulled out a slip of paper.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we sat, something crinkled in my..."
entries.dialogueText: As we sat, something crinkled in my suit pocket. When Hugo wasn't looking, I reached in and pulled out a slip of paper.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On it was a very long string of num..."
entries.dialogueText: On it was a very long string of numbers and the words "Call me if you need me -- RM".

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Of course they should. But at the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course they should. But at the end of the day, the Rizian people's allegiance should be to their king. Not their provincial leadership."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria shuffled some notes around. S..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria shuffled some notes around. She turned to look at the empty seat of the former RPP leader.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As everyone settled in, I and the o..."
entries.dialogueText: As everyone settled in, I and the others became aware of the sound of boots marching down the hallway, steadily increasing in volume.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty? What is going on?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty? What is going on?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One by one, soldiers from the Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: One by one, soldiers from the Rizian Armed Forces began entering the chamber. When the sound of boots stopped, a full squadron was lined up against the back wall, standing at attention.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If nobody objects, these gentlemen..."
entries.dialogueText: "If nobody objects, these gentlemen will be observing today's meeting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, what are you waiting for? Op..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, what are you waiting for? Open the session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know what you're all thinking. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what you're all thinking. But they're here to protect your freedom."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Objection, Your Majesty!""
entries.dialogueText: "Objection, Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a closer look at the new Hou..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a closer look at the new House Speaker. He wasn't wearing a sash or even a tie. There was a harshness to his features that made him seem older than his years.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You already have control over this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already have control over this parliament, Your Majesty. That you would bring these *enforcers* here only serves as proof that you are scared of your own people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a closer look at the new opp..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a closer look at the new opposition leader. He wasn't wearing a sash or even a tie. There was a harshness to his features that made him seem older than his years.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your objection is noted. But these..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your objection is noted. But these sessions are open to anyone who wants to join. Our guests will remain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our men and women in uniform are h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our men and women in uniform are here to keep anti-Crown fanatics like you from overstepping their bounds. They are staying."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will leave the decision to the H..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will leave the decision to the House Speaker."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I object, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I object, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My future son-in-law stood bolt upr..."
entries.dialogueText: My future son-in-law stood bolt upright at his podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus stood bolt upright at his pod..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus stood bolt upright at his podium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I respect the House Speaker's obje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect the House Speaker's objection. The soldiers will depart these premises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I respect your objection. The sold..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect your objection. The soldiers will depart these chambers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria's expression was conflicted a..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria's expression was conflicted as she spoke.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I agree that the presence of the R..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that the presence of the Rizian Armed Forces in these halls is both unorthodox and unnecessary."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a look of displeasure, Sal nod..."
entries.dialogueText: With a look of displeasure, Sal nodded. He, Sevrio and the other guards exited the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A look of displeasure spread across..."
entries.dialogueText: A look of displeasure spread across the RPP leader's face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment's hesitation, Daria..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment's hesitation, Daria rang her bell to open the session.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Daria Session Opening House Speaker]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But you're not House Speaker. I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're not House Speaker. I will let Daria de Rava decide this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shut his mouth angrily. After ta..."
entries.dialogueText: He shut his mouth angrily. After taking a moment to compose himself, he rang the bell on his podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment's hesitation, Adarfo..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment's hesitation, Adarfo rang his bell to open the session.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry. Who are you again?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. Who are you again?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""A messenger, Your Majesty. From yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A messenger, Your Majesty. From your own populace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment's hesitation, Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment's hesitation, Manus rang his bell to open the session.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here's a message for you. Be grate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here's a message for you. Be grateful I'm letting you speak. Now, don't you have a job to do?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Bringing armed forces into the Hou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bringing armed forces into the House of Delegates is a direct attack on democracy. The people will not stand for this."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""However, I default to His Majesty'..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I default to His Majesty's judgement. If the King wants them here, they will stay."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And of course, our... esteemed gue..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, our... esteemed guests in uniform."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And of course, our... esteemed gue..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, our... esteemed guests in uniform."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""And of course, our esteemed guests..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, our esteemed guests in uniform."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Moving with lightning speed, Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText: Moving with lightning speed, Lucita's soldiers sprang into action. They fanned out around the perimeter of the room, weapons drawn.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everybody froze in place. An eerie..."
entries.dialogueText: Everybody froze in place. An eerie silence descended.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's mouth hung open. For the fir..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's mouth hung open. For the first time since I'd known him, my uncle looked afraid of me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I suddenly realized that Adarfo was..."
entries.dialogueText: I suddenly realized that Adarfo was missing. He must have run out of the room in the initial chaos.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I suddenly realized that Manus was..."
entries.dialogueText: I suddenly realized that Manus was missing. He must have run out of the room in the initial chaos.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your King has spoken. You are all..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your King has spoken. You are all dismissed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quickly. Someone find the traitor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quickly. Someone find the traitor while the rest of you show these pawns the door."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Count yourselves lucky I am lettin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Count yourselves lucky I am letting you leave with your lives."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Two soldiers rushed out of the cham..."
entries.dialogueText: Two soldiers rushed out of the chamber while the others trained their weapons on the remaining Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers kept their weapons tra..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers kept their weapons trained on the remaining Delegates as they began filing out the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I suddenly realized that Adarfo and..."
entries.dialogueText: I suddenly realized that Adarfo and Manus were missing. They must have run out of the room in the initial chaos.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quickly. Someone find the traitors..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quickly. Someone find the traitors while the rest of you show these pawns the door."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The representatives left the room -..."
entries.dialogueText: The representatives left the room -- some terrified, others defiant.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A King has to make unpleasant choi..."
entries.dialogueText: "A King has to make unpleasant choices for the good of the nation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is true...""
entries.dialogueText: "This is true..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Was that a threat, Your Grace?""
entries.dialogueText: "Was that a threat, Your Grace?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle paled as my war councilor..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle paled as my war councilor walked up to stand beside me.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Duchess Azaro. Now I'm beginning t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro. Now I'm beginning to understand."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You must know how this will look f..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must know how this will look from the outside."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It will look like His Majesty taki..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will look like His Majesty taking the necessary steps for the security of his subjects."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shall we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her troops flanked us as we walked..."
entries.dialogueText: Her troops flanked us as we walked down the aisle of the chamber side by side, Hugo trailing behind.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well done, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well done, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My war councilor walked up to stand..."
entries.dialogueText: My war councilor walked up to stand beside me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't have done it without yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't have done it without you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What have we done?""
entries.dialogueText: "What have we done?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure it wasn't overkill?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure it wasn't overkill?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What was necessary.""
entries.dialogueText: "What was necessary."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It was necessary.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was necessary."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You're too modest.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're too modest."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shall we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her troops flanked us as we walked..."
entries.dialogueText: Her troops flanked us as we walked down the aisle of the now-empty chamber, side by side.
